# Orange Sound Guild

> Orange Sound Guild is a music streaming web app for uploading, discovering, and playing audio tracks from independent artists.

Orange Sound Guild also offers a free public ISRC & UPC Finder for looking up existing song recording codes and album release barcodes from Spotify’s catalog. No sign-in is required; the tool does not issue or assign new codes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest tracks and featured artists.
- [Top 100](/top100): The 100 most-played tracks right now.
- [Search](/search): Find artists, tracks and genres.
- [ISRC & UPC Finder](/isrc-finder): Free lookup for song ISRC codes and album UPC barcodes by title, Spotify link or code.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in to save playlists, follow artists, and upload.
